The '''New Republic Starfighter Corps''' was made up of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] non-[[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|naval]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. Famous in the Starfighter Corps was [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] of its predecessor, the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]].
